# Lead Lab Workspace
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent) on behalf of Agno JF

Technical delivery workspace for the private, self-hosted Lead Lab web application. It follows the Interpretable Context Methodology (ICM) through scoped stage contracts and plain-text handoffs.

## Folder Map

```text
workspace/
├── AGENTS.md
├── CONTEXT.md
├── references/
├── skills/
└── stages/
    ├── 01-define/
    ├── 02-design/
    ├── 03-build/
    ├── 04-measure/
    └── 05-learn/
```

## Task Routing

| Task | Go To | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Define a delivery request or new cycle | `stages/01-define/CONTEXT.md` | Establish outcome, boundary, inputs, and missing decisions |
| Verify environment or design the solution | `stages/02-design/CONTEXT.md` | Confirm capabilities and produce a stack-aware design |
| Build or change application source | `stages/03-build/CONTEXT.md` | Implement the smallest approved change and prepare evidence |
| Test or audit a build | `stages/04-measure/CONTEXT.md` | Check acceptance, security, quality, and evidence |
| Decide the next cycle | `stages/05-learn/CONTEXT.md` | Convert findings into actions, decisions, or blockers |
| Show pipeline status | Scan `stages/*/` | Report which stage artifacts exist |

## Cycle

```text
Define -> Design -> Build -> Measure -> Learn
             ^                 |
             |_________________|
```

The Learn stage may route work back to Define, Design, or Build. Measure and Learn are always the final two stages of a cycle.

## Run Rules

For the first cycle, propose `application/runs/` as `{{OUTPUT_ROOT}}`. Generate a run slug, show `{{RUN_PATH}}`, and confirm it before creating the run folder. Never overwrite a prior run.

Stage contracts define the minimal context to load. References are stable rules. Run outputs are working artifacts. Application source remains outside run folders as the canonical implementation.
